drills.label: Cold open
drills.question_line: SAM: Here is the customer. A logistics company runs on Azure
drills.answer_line: SAM: So the answer is A, hosted on Azure.
drills.scenario: Logistics company with an Azure commitment
drills.stem: Hard rules: prompts and completions stay inside Azure, and the spend counts against the Azure consumption commitment. The team might try Claude Managed Agents next year. Which route?

options.A: Claude in Microsoft Foundry, hosted on Azure
options.B: Claude in Microsoft Foundry, hosted on Anthropic
options.C: The Claude API, bought direct from Anthropic
options.D: Buy Claude through the company's cloud solution provider (CSP) partner

drills.why: Hosted on Azure keeps prompts and completions in Azure and draws down the commitment. B may process data outside the Azure geography and has no Managed Agents either. C misses the commitment. D: CSP subscriptions cannot buy Claude in Foundry.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. Choose two. A retailer runs Claude in Foundry, hosted on Azure.
drills.answer_line: SAM: B and D. The Files A P I is missing when hosted on Azure
drills.scenario: Retailer on Foundry, hosted on Azure
drills.stem: Choose two. Which two will fail on the hosted-on-Azure option?

options.A: Messages API calls authenticated with Entra ID
options.B: Uploading product catalogues through the Files API
options.D: A nightly job through the Message Batches API
options.E: Messages API calls authenticated with an API key

drills.why: Files API is missing when hosted on Azure; Batches is missing on Foundry under either option. Messages, token counting and both auth methods work.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. An insurer's platform team writes everything in C sharp
drills.answer_line: SAM: That is the loyal answer, and it ignores both constraints. The answer is B.
drills.scenario: C# insurer with Semantic Kernel code
drills.stem: A C#/.NET team with years of Semantic Kernel code wants multi-agent handoff, with Claude as the model for two agents. What do you recommend?

options.A: Rewrite the agents in Python on the Claude Agent SDK
options.B: Microsoft Agent Framework in C#, with its Anthropic model provider
options.C: Stay on AutoGen, since the patterns started there
options.D: A custom agent loop in C# from scratch

drills.why: Agent Framework succeeds Semantic Kernel, runs on .NET, has handoff built in and runs Claude through its Anthropic provider. A discards language and code, C is the predecessor, D rebuilds what ships.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. For each statement, say true or false. One: in a U K tenant today
drills.answer_line: SAM: All four. One: the U K default is no users.
drills.prompt: True or false? 1) In a UK tenant today, Claude is on by default in Microsoft 365 Copilot. 2) Under subprocessor terms, Claude in Microsoft 365 Copilot is covered by Microsoft's Product Terms and DPA. 3) Today, Claude in Copilot is inside the EU Data Boundary. 4) If an admin enables a Fable-class model with data retention, Anthropic is an independent processor and may keep inputs and outputs up to 30 days.
drills.answer: 1) False: UK default is no users. 2) True. 3) False: currently excluded, move announced for December. 4) True.

drills.label: Drill
drills.question_line: SAM: Pause here and answer before we go on. A software company with two thousand developers
drills.answer_line: SAM: B. A answers a question nobody asked
drills.stem: Security wants one control plane for every coding agent, one bill, and central control of enabled models. Developers want Claude models and the Claude coding agent. What do you recommend?

options.A: Replace GitHub Copilot with Claude Code for all developers
options.B: Keep GitHub Copilot, enable Claude models, use the Claude coding agent through Agent HQ
options.C: Tell them Copilot cannot run Claude, so they need two tools
options.D: Build an in-house coding agent on the Claude Agent SDK

drills.why: Every stated constraint is consolidation, and Copilot meets it with Claude inside. A breaks one bill, C is false, D builds a product when they asked to govern one.

drills.question_line: SAM: Recall first. Pause and name the four segments
drills.answer_line: ALEX: Foundry: must data stay in Azure
drills.prompt: Name the four segments, and the question you would ask the customer in each.
drills.answer: Foundry: must data stay in Azure, which features next year. Agent Framework: what language. Microsoft 365 Copilot: which tenant, region, model class. GitHub Copilot: consolidation or the full harness.
